CMOS 1T1C DRAM write/read slice
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
VP vpre 0 1.65
VR vref 0 1.65
VB vb 0 .9
VD din 0 PWL(0 3.3 230n 3.3 240n 0 500n 0)
VWL wl 0 PWL(0 3.3 50n 3.3 50.1n 0 120n 0 120.1n 3.3 160n 3.3 160.1n 0 250n 0 250.1n 3.3 300n 3.3 300.1n 0 370n 0 370.1n 3.3 410n 3.3 410.1n 0 500n 0)
VW we 0 PWL(0 3.3 50n 3.3 50.1n 0 250n 0 250.1n 3.3 300n 3.3 300.1n 0 500n 0)
VWB web 0 PWL(0 0 50n 0 50.1n 3.3 250n 3.3 250.1n 0 300n 0 300.1n 3.3 500n 3.3)
VPR pre 0 PWL(0 0 70n 0 70.1n 3.3 110n 3.3 110.1n 0 320n 0 320.1n 3.3 360n 3.3 360.1n 0 500n 0)
VPRB preb 0 PWL(0 3.3 70n 3.3 70.1n 0 110n 0 110.1n 3.3 320n 3.3 320.1n 0 360n 0 360.1n 3.3 500n 3.3)
XDUT vdd 0 wl cell din vpre bl web we preb pre vref vb dout astra_062_cmos_dram_write_read_slice
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec stored1 range 2.1 2.6 unit=V
* @spec pre1 range 1.63 1.67 unit=V
* @spec read1 range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec share1 range 2 2.5 unit=V
* @spec stored0 range -0.02 0.02 unit=V
* @spec pre0 range 1.63 1.67 unit=V
* @spec read0 range -0.02 0.02 unit=V
* @spec share0 range 0 0.4 unit=V
.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 100p 500n
meas tran stored1 FIND v(cell) AT=60n
meas tran pre1 FIND v(bl) AT=105n
meas tran read1 FIND v(dout) AT=150n
meas tran share1 FIND v(bl) AT=150n
meas tran stored0 FIND v(cell) AT=310n
meas tran pre0 FIND v(bl) AT=355n
meas tran read0 FIND v(dout) AT=400n
meas tran share0 FIND v(bl) AT=400n
write out.raw v(dout) v(cell) v(bl) v(wl) v(we) v(pre)
quit
.endc
.end
